Role-based training for administrators and the e-file team. Gap: CAS payroll staff and the offshore vendor staff have no role-based security training.

implementation_statement: The MSSP reviews SIEM alerts 24x7 and escalates high severity within 30 minutes. Gap: inbox-rule alerts were suppressed in the 2026 filing season; no review of tax software or DMS activity; no bulk-export alerting.

Controls are assessed each year by the co-sourced internal audit firm, which reports to the audit committee and does not operate any control (P07).

Connections to the tax software vendor, the offshore vendor, and the payroll vendor are covered by contracts. Gap: no documented interconnection terms for the offshore vendor's network connection to the virtual desktop gateway.
The POA&M (P07) tracks every weakness with an owner and date; the GRC Manager reviews it monthly and the audit committee quarterly.
The Chief Operating Officer accepted operation of the TCDP on 2026-09-22 with POA&M conditions; the Chief Executive Officer accepted the High risks temporarily.

Continuous monitoring of endpoints and identity through the MSSP; monthly metrics to the Chief Operating Officer. Gap: no monitoring of SaaS application activity, so the program does not meet the continuous monitoring alternative in 314.4(d)(2) and relies on annual penetration tests and vulnerability assessments instead.

Daily backups of the DMS, workpaper server, and file services to an immutable vault (35-day write-once retention) in a separate backup account with separate administrator credentials.
